post.title: AI Chatbots Ka Psychosis Risk? Seriously?
post.body: Feels kinda scary that AI is now being linked to psychosis risk. Barclays analysts recently ranked AI models on how well they handle mental health red flags, according to some reports from Wall Street. As someone working with AI tools daily, I honestly never thought about how badly some models could mess up sensitive conversations. It makes me wonder how safe it is for users who might already be struggling with mental health issues. Kya aap logon ne kabhi aise situations dekhe ho jahan AI responses seemed tone deaf or harmful? Share karo yaar.
post.source: Wall Street is beginning to worry about AI 'psychosis risk.' See which models ranked best and worst.

comments.text: Bhai ye AI kabhi kabhi simple baat bhi confuse kar deta hai toh mental health ko kaise samjhega? Lab toh bas stats pe kaam karta hai, empathy hona chahiye usme jo abhi missing hai for sure.

replies.text: Exactly yaar, empathy ki kami bada problem hai. OpenAI jaise companies ka effort dekh ke thoda hope milta hai but abhi distance zyada hai.

comments.text: Mental health ko seriously lena chal raha hai companies mein but jab AI hi confuse kare toh kya kare? I think training data pe kaafi kaam karna padega, warna aise models users ko galat advice denge jo dangerous ho sakta hai.
Great, ab AI bhi paagal ho sakti hai. Next thing we know toh AI therapists banake human therapists ko out of job kar dega, fir apna dil ka dard AI ke saamne sunayenge.

I work in ML and yes, AI models aren’t perfect. In fact the psychosis risk factor is a great example of why we have to keep surveillance on outputs and embed strict fail-safes. Models need better datasets representing real user distress signals, warna joke hi ban jayenge.
Mujhe yaad hai ek baar ek chatbot ne mere dost ko itna confuse kar diya itni complicated baatein ki woh toh aur upset ho gaya. AI me thoda more human touch lani hogi, warna log trust hi nahi karenge.

replies.text: True that, trust sabse important cheez hai. Jab tak AI genuinely help karne nahi lagta, tab tak risk hi risk lagega.

comments.text: Yeh risk to zaroori tha pata hona, specially for workplaces using AI for employee wellbeing. Maybe we should see these reports as warning signs and push for better policies before things get worse.

post.title: Design systems are a mess again in 2025?
post.body: I can’t believe we still struggle with design consistency even in 2025. According to the latest from the digital world, inconsistent buttons, colors or tone can seriously hurt conversions and brand image (source). For those of us working in design or product teams, this means more headaches making sure everyone follows the same system. comments.text: Yaar, I work in a startup and trust me, gaadi chalane wale sab apne hisaab se steer lete hai. Design guidelines toh banate hai but implementation zero. So frustrating when product and design teams don’t sync properly.

But firms need to clarify data usage policies to avoid confusion. I keep telling my company to be upfront about AI monitoring. Otherwise gaand phat sakti hai later.

Happy to see some relate. The privacy bit really stuck with me too, especially that Scople.AI thing not storing or sharing images. Feels like they get how annoying it is to share everything nowadays. Still, adapting to these AI tools at work + home is taxing.
Oh great, next whatever you wear will be judged by AI in washing machines. Kya karein, ab hamari lives AI selfies lene wali hain.

replies.text: Hahaha sahi bola, AI selfie lene ki age aagayi. I’m waiting for smart fridge to roast me too.

comments.text: If you feel overwhelmed, start small. Pick one AI tool at work or home, learn it properly. Don’t jump on every new thing. Privacy settings bahut check karna zaroori hai and don’t hesitate to say no agar lagta hai zyada intrusive ho raha hai.
I wonder if this AI will judge my coffee habits next, bhai I barely manage work stress and now AI wants report card also. Kab tak chill kar paenge yaar?

replies.text: Haha, I feel you. Work stress plus AI ka feedback loop thoda zyada lagta hai sometimes. Hope they keep it helpful and not annoying.
